generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Bid Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional bids will not be accepted.
The bid is of two cover system.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in

Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e- Procurement, can be contacted the office of the Executive Engineer (O&M)GP, KPCL, Gerusoppa-581 384, Honavar-Tq, Uttara Kannada- Dist, Karnataka or HELPDESK 91 80450 10000

Form of bid (Annexure-A), Instruction to Bidders (Annexure-B), Form of Guarantee Bond (Annexure-C), Form of Contract Agreement (Annexure-D), Acceptance of important Clauses of Bid (Annexure- E), e-Bid conditions (Annexure-F), Self declaration by Bidder (Annexure-G), e-portal declaration(Annexure - H), Format of Under Taking for Employment (Annexure I), Uploaded Documents (Annexure - J), Section-I, Section-II, Section-III are part of the Bid document.

The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only & Quoted in the website itself. The bidder should quote prices for each item exclusive of GST & inclusive of other loadings /additional on FOR destination basis which considered as landing cost.The GST and other components of quoted price should be clearly mentioned in COMPONENTS of schedule at e-portal. Any clarifications regarding this can be had with HELP DESK of e-portal.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the bid/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.

The bidders should have independent PF(Provident Fund) registration certificate obtained from PF authorities and remit the PF towards the labours deployed for work to their Establishment Code obtained from PF authorities.
The bid of the bidders whose contracts have been terminated / foreclosed in KPCL or elsewhere during last 03 years will be rejected.

The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in bid may vary depending on the requirement at the time of placing of the work order. The bidder shall visit the site for assessing of quantity, type and specification.
The scope of work includes the Design, Manufacture, Supply, Retrofit, Testing and Commissioning of 11 KV KIOSK feeder breakers at Gerusoppa Power House, as detailed in Section III.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have sufficient experience in execution of similar nature of VCB supply and erection/retrofitting works in any Government or semi government or reputed organization in India. In proof of experience, Work Order with its Work done certificate for at least one single Work Order which executed in last five financial years (ie. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) in the name of bidder with the Contract value not less than Rs.20.93 Lakhs issued by the competent authorities shall be furnished. The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs.41.86 Lakhs in any two financial years of last five financial years (ie. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof, the agency should furnish annual turnover certificate/Profit & Loss Statement issued by Chartered accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10 percentage per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.
